content.title: About
content.content: Cereal, O's, multigrain are whole‑grain ring‑shaped flakes enriched with vitamins and minerals. They are made from a blend of wheat, oats, rice and corn, providing a balanced mix of carbohydrates, fiber and protein. The flakes have a light crunchy texture and a mild aroma, perfect for a breakfast with milk or yogurt.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend includes five different grains, giving higher nutritional value than single‑grain cereals.
The flakes are fortified with B‑vitamins, iron and zinc to support energy metabolism and immunity.
The ring shape was designed for easy portion control and even milk absorption.
The product contains no artificial colors or flavors.
Packaging is made from recyclable material and can be reused.

items.title: Rich in dietary fiber
items.content: The whole‑grain blend provides a high amount of fiber, which aids digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Complex carbs release energy slowly, helping maintain stable blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2, B6 and folate support energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Fortified with minerals
items.content: Iron, zinc and magnesium contribute to immune health, blood formation and muscle function.

items.title: Low added sugar
items.content: Added sugar content is minimal, making the cereal suitable for moderate consumption.

items.title: Grain allergy
items.content: People allergic to wheat, oats or other grains may experience reactions.

items.title: Contains gluten
items.content: Not suitable for individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: High glycemic impact with sweeteners
items.content: Adding honey, syrup or other sweeteners can raise the glycemic index.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour milk, kefir or a plant‑based drink over the flakes and let them sit for 2–3 minutes. They can also be mixed into yogurt, smoothies, used in baking, or as a crunchy topping for fruit salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed package. For longer shelf life, keep in the refrigerator to preserve crunchiness and prevent fat oxidation.
